fields.description: Program Description Academic Year & Curriculum This is a 4-year program, 3 trimesters per academic year. Curriculum (160 Credits) Program Orientation The program aims to enable students to be proficient in Chinese language communication, to understand the essential knowledge in health management and thus to engage in health monitoring and consulting service. Main Courses · Intermediate Chinese Listening & Speaking · Intermediate Chinese Reading & Writing · Advanced Chinese · Basic Chinese of Traditional Chinese Medicine · Foundation of Disease · General Introduction to Traditional Chinese Medicine · Health Education · Health Management · Health Policy · History of Chinese Medicine · Design and Management of Healthy Diet · Nutritional Epidemiology · Nutrition Management in Clinical Practice Graduation and Academic Degree A Bachelor of Arts will be awarded upon completion of · Required credits of all courses in the teaching scheme (Attachment 1) · Pass of all examinations · New HSK 6≥180

CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements High school graduation or above; certified transcripts of A-Level course, IB or AP. New HSK 4≥180 (for non-Chinese ethnics) or pass the entrance examination of Chinese in SHUTCM. Applicants emigrating from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan must hold a valid foreign citizenship for no less than 4 years and a record of residency in the country for no less than 2 years in the most recent 4 years (Before April 30, 2024). (Actual residency for 9 months can be counted as one year based on entry and exit stamps). 16-65 years old.
